title: note_type.created
description: Creates a user-defined note type. Built-ins are seeded, never created by ops. OPS.md#note_typecreated

id.description: Id of the new note type. Equals the envelope's entity_id.

base_type.description: Which of the six note types this is. Immutable.

fields.description: Ordered field definitions; the whole array is ONE register ('fields'). Keys must be unique within the array (server rejects duplicates with invalid_value). Keys are never renamed. For base_type vocab the keys MUST include expression, reading and meaning (server rejects otherwise with invalid_value; OPS.md, C-2).

items.description: One field. Unknown keys are preserved.

key.description: Field key used in note.fields and {{placeholders}}.

templates.description: Card kinds: {kind: template}. Each kind is its own register 'templates.<kind>'.

css.description: Extra CSS appended after assets/card/ CSS. Default ''.
